tools.name: search_rings
tools.description: Search dated smart-ring records by brand/model, phone, use case and buyer country. Unknown availability is not treated as available.

tools.name: compare_rings
tools.description: Read the original evidence, limitations, sizing, battery and subscription records for two to four ring IDs. Not a hands-on review or diagnosis.

tools.name: calculate_ring_cost
tools.description: Calculate 1–3 year hardware plus required subscription cost in the recorded currency. Not a local quote; no exchange-rate conversion, taxes or optional fees.

tools.name: find_regional_offers
tools.description: Read country-specific official and paid retailer links for one ring. Preserve affiliate URLs. Brand storefronts and model searches are not exact listings; no checkout or live inventory.
